title: Industry Discovery & Attention v1
description: A broad reusable pool of new topic and keyword territories derived from a valid Core Industry Context. The Core input is read-only context, not output to rewrite. Generate many distinct useful candidates rather than limiting output to 3-5 items. Candidates are territories, not finished article titles or headlines.
x-generation-rules: Every item must have a reasonable contextual bridge to the supplied Core Industry Context.
Prefer breadth of distinct candidates over verbose explanations.

Primary keywords are short SEO-capable seed phrases: normally 1-4 words and strongly prefer 5 words or fewer. Longer phrases are allowed only when meaning cannot be preserved; long natural searches belong in query_examples.

When language is vi, human-readable values must primarily be Vietnamese. English acronyms or standard terms may be included with a Vietnamese explanation where useful; do not produce entire descriptions or headings in English.

topic.description: Reusable topic territory, never a finished headline.

query_examples.description: Optional longer natural search expressions; do not treat these mechanically as primary keywords.
